notes.title: Battle Mode Update
notes.content:
[b]Battle Mode is here! [/b]

Compete with friends (locally) in deathmatch mode. 
You can use all purchased weapons, as well as melee attacks, grenades, and jumpsuit attacks to cause even more chaos.

What's more in version 1.1
[list]
[*] added Vsync in options menu
[*] balanced collectable money
[*] minor fixes
[/list]
